pageDescription: Open roles, candidates and interviews — intake, decisions and the atomic hire into Employees.

jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Create a job to start a hiring pipeline.
jobs.emptyFiltered: No jobs match these filters. Clear a filter or search for another title.
jobs.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every job field.
jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.containerLabel: Jobs. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

jobForm.createDescription: Create a job in draft, then open it to start accepting candidates.
jobForm.editDescription: Update the job while it is a draft or open. Closing is a separate, terminal action.
jobForm.title: Title
jobForm.openingsHint: Hiring stops once this many candidates are hired.
jobForm.descriptionHint: Visible to HR and managers running the pipeline. Do not include candidate details.
jobForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What the role covers, who it reports to and what success looks like.

jobState.openDescription: Open “{title}” so HR can add candidates and hire against its openings.
jobState.closeDescription: Close “{title}”? Closing is terminal — the job cannot be re-opened, and new candidates and hires will be refused. Candidates already in the pipeline can still be moved.

candidates.empty: No candidates yet. Add a candidate to an open job to start the pipeline.
candidates.emptyForJob: No candidates for this job yet. Add a candidate to start the pipeline.
candidates.emptyFiltered: No candidates match these filters. Clear a filter or search for another name.
candidates.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every candidate field.
candidates.label: Candidates
candidates.containerLabel: Candidates. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

candidateForm.createDescription: Add an application to an open job. Intake is HR-entered — candidates never sign in to WorkPulse.
candidateForm.editDescription: Update the candidate's contact details. Stage moves and hiring are separate actions.
candidateForm.jobHint: Only open jobs accept new candidates.
candidateForm.noOpenJobs: No job is open. Open a job first — candidates can only be added to an open job.
candidateForm.notesHint: Sensitive: visible to HR only and never included in events.
candidateForm.notesPlaceholder: Context for the hiring team — never shared with the candidate.

candidateDecision.rejectDescription: Reject {name}? This is terminal — a later comeback is a new candidate row.
candidateDecision.withdrawDescription: Record that {name} withdrew. This is terminal — the candidate can no longer be moved.
candidateDecision.noteHint: Sensitive: visible to HR only and never included in events.
candidateDecision.rejectNotePlaceholder: Why this candidate is no longer moving forward.
candidateDecision.withdrawNotePlaceholder: What the candidate told you, if anything.

hire.title: Hire candidate
hire.description: Create the Employee record for {name} from “{job}”. The department, position and location come from the job.
hire.overrideNote: Leave a field empty to use the candidate record.

interviews.empty: No interviews yet. Schedule one for an interviewing candidate.
interviews.emptyFiltered: No interviews match these filters. Clear a filter to see the full schedule.
interviews.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every interview field.
interviews.label: Interviews
interviews.containerLabel: Interviews. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

interviewForm.createDescription: Schedule a conversation with an interviewing candidate. Only the assigned interviewer files the feedback.
interviewForm.editDescription: Move the conversation, re-assign the interviewer or update its notes while it is scheduled.
interviewForm.candidateHint: Only interviewing candidates can be scheduled.
interviewForm.noCandidates: No candidate is interviewing. Advance a candidate to interviewing first.
interviewForm.scheduledAtHint: Your local time; stored in UTC.
interviewForm.notesHint: Sensitive: never included in events or audit values.
interviewForm.notesPlaceholder: Context for the conversation — visible to HR and the interviewer.

feedback.title: Submit feedback
feedback.description: {name} · {time}. Submitting completes the interview; the candidate's stage stays with HR.
feedback.notesHint: Sensitive: visible to HR and never included in events or audit values.
feedback.notesPlaceholder: What stood out, what to probe further and how the candidate compares.

cancel.title: Cancel interview
cancel.description: Cancel the interview with {name} on {time}? This is terminal — the conversation cannot be re-opened.
cancel.noteHint: Sensitive: visible to HR only and never included in events.
cancel.notePlaceholder: Why the conversation is no longer happening.

myInterviews.empty: No interviews are assigned to you yet. When HR schedules one, it appears here.
myInterviews.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every interview field.
myInterviews.label: My interviews
myInterviews.containerLabel: My interviews. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

errors.jobNotFound: This job is no longer available.
errors.candidateNotFound: This candidate is no longer available.
errors.interviewNotFound: This interview is no longer available.
errors.interviewerNotFound: Choose an employee from your organization as the interviewer.
errors.jobNotDraft: Only a draft job can be opened. Refresh and try again.
errors.jobNotOpen: This job's state no longer allows that action. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.jobOpeningsFilled: Every opening on this job is filled. Increase the openings before hiring again.
errors.candidateAlreadyApplied: This candidate has already applied to this job.
errors.candidateStageConflict: The candidate isn't at the stage this action needs. Refresh and try again.
errors.candidateNotOpen: This candidate is already closed and can't be rejected or withdrawn again.
errors.interviewNotScheduled: This interview is no longer scheduled. Refresh and try again.
errors.interviewerNotActive: That employee is no longer active and can't be assigned.
errors.employeeEmailTaken: An employee already uses this email. Override the email or update the existing record.
errors.employeeCodeTaken: This employee code is already in use.
errors.employeeManagerInvalid: Choose an active manager inside your organization.
errors.departmentNotFound: The selected department no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.positionNotFound: The selected position no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.locationNotFound: The selected location no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to manage recruitment.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: This item is no longer available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.titleTooLong: Title must be at most 200 characters
validation.descriptionTooLong: Description must be at most 5,000 characters
validation.openingsInt: Openings must be a whole number
validation.openingsMin: A job needs at least one opening
validation.firstNameTooLong: First name must be at most 200 characters
validation.lastNameTooLong: Last name must be at most 200 characters
validation.emailTooLong: Email must be at most 320 characters
validation.phoneTooLong: Phone must be at most 50 characters
validation.notesTooLong: Notes must be at most 2,000 characters
validation.noteTooLong: Note must be at most 500 characters
validation.hireDateFuture: Hire date can't be in the future
validation.employeeCodeTooLong: Employee code must be at most 50 characters
validation.dateTimeInvalid: Choose a valid date and time
validation.interviewNotesTooLong: Notes must be at most 1,000 characters
validation.feedbackTooLong: Feedback must be at most 1,000 characters
